Company highlights to include strategy for entering CD228V Co-development and Licensing Agreement and Proposed SkinJect® Business Combination and Concurrent Financing LOI


PHILADELPHIA, Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Medicus Pharma Ltd. (NASDAQ: MDCX) (“Medicus” or the “Company”), a precision guided, biotech/life sciences company focused on advancing the clinical development programs of novel and potentially disruptive therapeutic assets, today announced that it will host a financial performance and business update conference call on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time, following the filing of its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026.


During the call, amongst other things, management will discuss the strategy relating to the Company’s decision to enter the CD228V Co-development and licensing agreement with Pfizer, Inc. (“Pfizer”) and proposed SkinJect® business combination (“Business Combination”) with an undisclosed special purpose acquisition company (“SPAC”) and concurrent financing non-binding Letter of Intent (“LOI”).


**Conference call details:**


- **Date:** Monday, November 9, 2026
- **Time:** 11:30 a.m. ET
- **Dial-in (U.S./Canada, toll-free):** 1-833-890-6070
- **Dial-in (international):** 1-412-504-9736
- **Webcast:**[https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=uSGLPByg](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=uSGLPByg)


**Participants will include:**


- **Raza Bokhari, MD – Exec. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer**
- **Carolyn Bonner—President and Chief Financial Officer**
- **Faisal Mehmud, MD—Chief Medical Officer**


**Topics will include:**


- Financial performance of the Company and overview of the business outlook
- Rationale for entering into the CD228V Co-development and Licensing agreement with Pfizer
- Proposed SkinJect Business Combination and Concurrent Financing LOI
- Development and partnership outlook for the Teverelix Program


Participants may pre-register at any time, including up to and after the call start time. Those unable to pre-register can participate by dialing 1-833-890-6070 (U.S./Canada) or 1-412-504-9736 (international). A webcast of the call can be accessed[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=eQVkiDw4laJpUMSd7YYu6WeD76D9BIH9EB50LbvDXg-aidEKkus92oOPQ1Xv5JPFqdO2O_VCHojF901BNrQn1EIEwhEWQek44CBuSOt4vB5oSYEG5VO2TesY9ZnlwaO38IgcUwD77glMcptQFRIXJg==) .

***About Medicus Pharma Ltd***


*Medicus Pharma Ltd. (Nasdaq: MDCX) is a precision-guided biotech/life sciences company focused on advancing the clinical development programs of novel and potentially disruptive therapeutic assets. The Company is actively engaged in multiple countries across three continents.*


*The Company’s current therapeutic assets are:*


***CD228V ADC, an investigational antibody-drug conjugate molecule utilizing Pfizer’s established vedotin linker-payload platform*** *, directed against melanotransferrin (CD228), a cell-surface protein expressed across multiple solid tumor types, such as melanoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), and esophageal cancer.*


***SkinJect*** ® ***, an*** ***investigational*** ***novel localized immuno-oncology precision product*** *focused on basal cell carcinoma (BCC) lesions in* ***Gorlin Syndrome patients*** *, a rare autosomal dominant disease also called nevoid BCC syndrome.*


***Teverelix®, an*** ***investigational*** ***next-generation GnRH antagonist,*** *is being developed as a first-in-market product for cardiovascular high-risk advanced prostate cancer patients, patients with acute urinary retention relapse (AURr) episodes due to enlarged prostate* *and symptomatic endometriosis.*


*Medicus’ strategy is to advance select programs through Phase 2 proof-of-concept and key clinical and regulatory inflection points that substantially reduce development risk and increase their attractiveness to potential pharmaceutical partners. By generating decision-grade clinical, regulatory and operational datasets, the Company seeks to create opportunities for strategic collaborations, regional licensing transactions and broader commercialization partnerships with established pharmaceutical companies. As data matures across its programs, Medicus intends to continue building differentiated development packages designed to maximize asset value while maintaining capital efficiency and development focus.*
